mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expression_calib (child_id, emotion_type, landmark_data, media_url, created_at) VALUES (#{childId}, #{emotionType}, #{landmarkData}, #{mediaUrl}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE landmark_data = VALUES(landmark_data) , media_url = VALUES(media_url) , created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT calib_id , child_id , emotion_type , landmark_data , media_url , created_at FROM expression_calib WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY calib_id
